title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men suffered non-life-threatening injuries in a shooting on Hancock St. in Dorchester Friday night.
One man was hospitalized, and the other sought medical attention himself, according to Boston police.
No suspects have been identified, and police continue to investigate the incident.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman was injured at MBTA Davis Station after her clothing got caught in an escalator mechanism.
A fellow rider activated the emergency stop button, aiding the injured woman, who was hospitalized for a hand injury.
This is the second escalator incident at Davis Station in 2026; a man died in a similar accident earlier this year.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Deivi Yoander Sanchez Aguasvivas and Luis Miguel Ramirez-Astacio charged with armed robbery and assault in Dorchester.
Victim reported being robbed at knifepoint by suspects on a blue moped near 140 Humboldt Ave.
Aguasvivas was arraigned and held without bail; Ramirez-Astacio had multiple outstanding warrants for similar charges.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends participatory budgeting submission deadline to August 7 for $2 million spending proposals.
Residents can propose one-time investment projects under Boston's authority via participate.boston.gov or by calling 617-635-3059.
City staff will review proposals in August with community forums planned before voting on finalists in early 2027.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit two home runs in his first two at-bats against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Saturday.
Rafaela's home runs were a 389-foot in the first inning and a 402-foot in the third inning off Yoshinobu Yamamoto.
Rafaela hit a total of three home runs in the series, bringing his season total to 14 by the third inning Saturday.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox made a substantial prospect-based offer for Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz, but no deal was reached.
Elly De La Cruz would have been an immediate upgrade for the Red Sox's middle infield, which is a high priority.
Boston is pursuing shortstops aggressively before the August 3 deadline, but hesitates to trade top prospect Franklin Arias.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye reports his shoulder is fully recovered after injury during last season's AFC Championship and Super Bowl.
The Patriots have bolstered their offense with additions like A.J. Brown, improving team dynamics at training camp.
Patriots face a challenging schedule, kicking off with a Super Bowl rematch against the Seattle Seahawks in Week 1.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4 on Friday night, showcasing their playoff potential.
Ceddanne Rafaela led the Red Sox comeback with crucial plays, supported by strong performances from Jarren Duran and Andruw Monasterio.
Despite key absences, Boston's resilient lineup suggests they should be aggressive buyers before the trade deadline.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela's two-run homer in the seventh inning led the Boston Red Sox to a 9-4 win over the Dodgers.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, maintaining Boston's lead and boosting his relief ERA to an MLB-best 0.69.
The Red Sox concluded July with a 21-4 record, marking their best performance in any calendar month in team history.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Gabe Jacas, Patriots' 2026 second-round pick, made a limited practice debut after recovering from knee surgery.
Christian Gonzalez is involved in contract negotiations with the Patriots, despite the ongoing stalemate.
Undrafted free agent Tanner Arkin impressed during training camp, earning reps with New England's first-team unit.
